people.name: Thongvor Silver-Blood
people.firstMeet: In Understone Keep, Markarth, by day; he lives in the Treasury House.
changes: Once Investigate the Hall of the Dead has begun, he waits at a spot in Understone Keep at all hours until a related quest's scene is done.
If he's put in the civil war's exiled faction he lives in the Palace of the Kings in Windhelm instead (and hides upstairs there during the battle for Windhelm).
people.role: Silver-Blood noble; the Stormcloaks' Jarl of Markarth if they take the Reach

quests.how: a step in it: he can speak as the Jarl of Markarth, before the cannibals are dealt with

unsure.why: The Stormcloak jarl role comes from an alias in an unnamed quest and his jarl faction rank; which civil-war outcome makes him jarl isn't named in the extracts.
The Understone Keep wait depends on an unnamed quest's stages; the exiled faction and the Windhelm quest aren't named in the extracts.
His home and visit packages carry a condition the extract doesn't decode (function 606), so they may not always apply.
He fills aliases in nine more quests that have no name in the extracts.
Only a class record id and an outfit id are in the extracts; neither resolves to a name, skills or a weapon here, so I can't say how they fight.
His two visit packages carry a "not dead" check with no target in the extract; it may be on him or on the person he visits.

changes: After Windhelm By The Sea he may adopt a child from Honorhall Orphanage in Riften.
He's in the Imperial court's steward line for Windhelm, so a civil-war outcome may give him a post in the Palace of the Kings.
people.role: part of a quest; in line to be Windhelm's steward on the Imperial side
